description: Listed companies in a GICS-aligned sector, industry group, industry or sub-industry (worldgdp.org classification from filed activity codes: SEC SIC codes for US listings, TSE 33 sectors for Japan, industry profiles for primary listings above $500m in ~35 other markets): name, ticker, exchange, company country and size band (Mega > US$200bn, Large > US$10bn, Mid > US$2bn, Small), largest first. No prices or valuations. Pair with get_sectors to set survey readings next to the stocks they affect.

market.description: all, or a company country code (US, JP, DE, UK, FR, CN, KR, IN, ...; EL = Greece)
